security_audit.summary: The external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks in examples and inline command names, not executable code. The network findings are documentation links to Bun and GitHub CLI, not outbound requests. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the scanned files.

static_findings.snippet: CLI tools for GitHub pull request operations. Designed to support automated code review workflows. R
- `pr-number` - PR number (optional, defaults to current branch's PR)
- `shouldReview` - boolean indicating if review should proceed
- `pr-number` - PR number (optional, defaults to current branch's PR)
- `--json` - Output as JSON array with file contents
- `pr-number` - PR number (optional if on a PR branch)
These tools wrap the GitHub CLI (`gh`). For operations not covered by these utilities, use `gh` dire

content.value_statement: Code review coordination often needs repeated GitHub CLI checks and comments. This skill documents PR review helpers for triage, guideline lookup, and inline feedback.
actual_capabilities: Documents a command for deciding whether a pull request needs review.
Defines criteria for skipping closed, draft, bot, previously reviewed, or trivial pull requests.
Documents lookup of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files related to changed paths.
Documents JSON output for guideline file paths and contents.
Documents inline PR comments on a file line or line range.
Shows direct GitHub CLI commands for PR details, diffs, comments, and file contents.
limitations: Requires Bun and an authenticated GitHub CLI installation.
The scanned package does not include the referenced helper source files.
Inline comments require valid paths and line numbers from the PR diff.
Actions use the permissions of the signed-in GitHub account.

use_cases.title: Screen PRs Before Review
use_cases.description: Decide whether a pull request is ready for review before spending time on the diff.

use_cases.title: Find Project Review Rules
use_cases.description: Locate AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files that apply to files changed in a pull request.

use_cases.title: Post Focused Inline Feedback
use_cases.description: Create line-specific GitHub review comments for confirmed issues in a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Check Review Need
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for one pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the github-pr skill to check whether pull request 123 needs review. Explain the decision in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Find Relevant Guidelines
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate preparation before reading the diff.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use github-pr to list guideline files for pull request 123. Summarize which files should guide the review.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Inline Feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review comment for a specific file line.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use github-pr to prepare an inline comment for src/auth.ts line 67. The issue is missing OAuth callback error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Run Review Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced end-to-end pull request review support.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use github-pr to evaluate pull request 123, gather relevant guidelines, inspect the diff with gh, and post concise inline comments for confirmed issues only.

output_examples.input: Check whether PR 123 should be reviewed.
output_examples.output: The assistant states whether review should proceed, gives the documented reason, and names the PR number that was checked.

output_examples.input: Find review guidance for PR 123 with changed component files.
output: The assistant lists root and path-specific guideline files.
When full output is requested, it summarizes the returned guideline content.

output_examples.output: The assistant posts an inline GitHub review comment with the requested body after confirming the file path and line number.

best_practices: Confirm the target repository and pull request number before running commands.
Read applicable AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md guidance before writing review comments.
Post inline comments only for concrete, actionable issues in the diff.
anti_patterns: Do not post comments without checking that the line still exists in the PR diff.
Do not use the skill from an account with broader GitHub permissions than needed.
Do not skip project guidelines when reviewing files in governed directories.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It documents helper commands for GitHub pull request triage, guideline lookup, and inline review comments.

faq.question: Does it require GitHub access?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an authenticated GitHub CLI session and uses that account for GitHub actions.

faq.question: Can it decide when to skip a PR?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented check considers draft status, closed state, bot authorship, previous AI review, and small change size.

faq.question: Can it find review instructions?
faq.answer: Yes. It looks for AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files in root, changed directories, and parent directories.

faq.question: Can it post inline comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents posting comments on a specific file line or line range in a pull request.

faq.question: What should users verify first?
faq.answer: Users should verify the repository, PR number, GitHub account, file path, and line number before posting comments.
